title: Custom Bulb Filling Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the provided fields (the protocol can fill up to 432 custom tubes per run).

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware files (JSON extensions) to upload.

steps.title: Upload .py protocol file
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload your protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App (refer to support articles for calibration tips).
